scoring_justification: The agent's full rigid-plastic FEM simulation cannot be re-run in the verifier sandbox; the checker directly compares the agent's reported stroke and thickness artifacts to paper-reported gold values/tol.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold critical punch strokes for material A under two drawing conditions (r_p=2 mm, d0=80 mm and r_p=8 mm, d0=77 mm)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text (Figure 5 and Figure 9): critical punch stroke 6.3 mm for condition (i) and 11.0 mm for condition (ii)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for the exact reproduction cases.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold thickness profile for condition (i) at fracture initiation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: digitized approximation of Figure 8 of the paper for material A
hidden_assets.generation_method: synthetic profile: initial thickness 0.70 mm with a Gaussian thinning dip of 0.12 mm centered at 20.5 mm (sigma=2 mm), mimicking the experimental thickness distribution.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Approximates the paper's measured thickness distribution; the exact shape is not critical—the checker verifies that the agent reproduces the correct thinning location and magnitude.

outputs.description: Critical punch strokes at fracture initiation for condition (i) (r_p=2 mm, d0=80 mm) and condition (ii) (r_p=8 mm, d0=77 mm). The hidden checker compares these reported values to the paper's gold values (6.3 mm and 11.0 mm) within a composite tolerance.

Through‑thickness‑averaged sheet thickness profile at the critical fracture stroke for condition (i). The hidden checker computes mean absolute error against a digitized reference profile from the paper.

output_contract.notes: Only material A is considered. The two specific drawing conditions are as listed. The calibration and simulation steps are process steps that must be genuinely executed to produce the scored artifacts.
